subgroup_definitions.card_seen: card_id present in the model's training rows
subgroup_definitions.card_unseen: card_id absent from training rows (implies uid unseen: uid extends card_id)
subgroup_definitions.uid_seen: uid present in the model's training rows
subgroup_definitions.uid_unseen: uid absent from training rows (new card, or known card with a new addr1)
subgroup_definitions.card_seen_uid_unseen: known card_id but a uid not in training rows (e.g. new addr1)
subgroup_definitions.no_entity_key: card1 missing, so no card_id/uid can be formed

gap_assumption: gap lengths are a sensitivity grid, not measured chargeback latency; the gap period is excluded from training and evaluation, and larger gaps also shrink training data
